errors.text_span: Die Exporte werden durch eine durchgezogene blaue Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: In the figure, exports (Exporte) are shown as a pink/mauve line, not blue. The blue line represents imports (Importe).

errors.text_span: Die Importe werden durch eine durchgezogene braune Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: In the figure, imports (Importe) are shown as a blue line, not brown. The pink/mauve line represents exports (Exporte).

errors.text_span: die bei 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt
errors.evidence: The exports (pink line) start at approximately 130 billion USD at the beginning of 2020, not 150 billion USD.

errors.text_span: im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 350 Milliarden US-Dollar endet
errors.evidence: The description assigns 350 billion to exports, but exports (pink line) end around 180 billion USD. The blue imports line reaches approximately 340-350 billion USD at the end.

errors.text_span: im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 330 Milliarden US-Dollar endet
errors.evidence: The description assigns 330 billion to imports (labeled as brown line), but the imports (blue line) end near 340-350 billion, while exports end near 180 billion.

errors.text_span: Die linke Skala reicht von -200 bis 400 und die rechte Skala reicht von -100 bis 400
errors.evidence: Looking at the figure, the left scale ranges from 0 to 400 (with values 50, 100, 150... 400 visible), and the right scale ranges from approximately -200 to 400. The description has the ranges swapped and incorrectly states the left scale goes to -200.

errors.text_span: einem minimalen Wert von -190 Milliarden US-Dollar im zweiten Quartal 2022
errors.evidence: The minimum value of the trade balance bars appears to be around -150 to -160 on the right scale at the end of 2023, not -190. The deep negative appears at the end of 2023, not in Q2 2022.

errors.text_span: einem maximalen Wert von 190 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2021
errors.evidence: The trade balance bars represent negative values (deficits) throughout the period on the right scale. There is no positive value of 190 billion; the bars fluctuate between approximately 0 and -150 on the right scale.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und stellt quartalsweise Zeiträume dar
errors.evidence: The x-axis appears to show monthly data, not quarterly data, as the bars and data points are more frequent than quarterly intervals.
The description does not mention that the trade balance bars are light blue in color and appear to extend downward (negative values) for most of the period, with a sharp drop at the end of 2023.
